# Local inspection reads the real stopped database, not endpoint credentials.
physical-init data
physical-snapshot data

! stderr .
stdout '"geometry_status":"complete"'
physical-json
physical-unchanged data
! exists never-created-token

# Human output keeps the qualification boundary visible.
skygo state retention inspect --data-dir data
! stderr .
stdout 'schema and binding geometry only; not a migration safety certificate'
stdout 'jobs: 0'
